line: Ten suns scorch the earth until the archer Hou Yi draws his bow, told with leather puppets on a lit screen.
line_cn: 十日炙烤大地，后羿张弓射日。

transitions: Transitions: lamps dimming, a blurred foreground pillar wipe, a piece lifting off in light, a flash to warm white;
never a generic crossfade or digital wipe.
labels: Subtitles belong to the theatre: a storyteller's placard (narrow dark-lacquer board, thin gold line, small carved seal), a label on a rod, or letters carved into hide. Classical OFL serif (e.g. Cormorant Garamond 600), 40–50 px, cream on dark, short slide in. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Titles are puppets: dark hide plaques with letters cut out (fillText + destination-out, so words glow), a carved border, carried on rods, pressed on to enter, lifted off to exit.
motion: 24 fps continuous for puppets and camera; only swapped effect pieces (fire, water) step at 12 fps.
Hand tremor on every puppet (a few px, ~0.02 rad, low-frequency), stronger under tension.
Body glides with the main rod; legs, plumes, tassels are simulated (damped pendulums / spring chains driven by body acceleration, pre-simulated at a fixed rate for determinism).
Operatic phrasing: shuffling run → hop → crouch → freeze pose on a percussion accent (~1 s, only loose parts quiver) → head turn.

native_moves.name: The light is the world
native_moves.does: Lamp count drives heat and colour.
native_moves.fits: city lights spreading at night; a fever rising and falling; servers switching on one by one.

native_moves.name: Off the screen = big and blurry
native_moves.does: A piece pulled toward the lamp grows and blurs.
native_moves.fits: a rumour growing; a memory fading; a deadline pressing onto the cloth and snapping sharp.

native_moves.name: Go behind the screen
native_moves.fits: how a product is really made; who controls a market; a teacher revealing the method.

native_moves.name: Carved and translucent
native_moves.does: Holes glow, overlaps darken, open faces vs solid.
native_moves.fits: an x-ray of a system; good and bad actors in a fable; layers of a city.

native_moves.name: Hand-held
native_moves.fits: a nervous interview; a tightrope; a toddler's first steps.

native_moves.name: Piece swap
native_moves.does: One carved piece on a rod replaced by another.
native_moves.fits: seasons; a machine's states; weather over a harvest.

native_moves.name: Strip lift-off
native_moves.does: A band of scenery lifted to reveal another.
native_moves.fits: geological layers; before/after a flood; an old town under a new one.
